title: The Secret in Their Eyes (bc30)
synopsis: For 25 years, a murder case has remained indelibly etched on Benjamín Espósito’s mind. Now retired, he decides to go back over that story and take another look at a past full of love, death and friendship. Telling a story from the past is no longer just a pastime to fill his empty hours. If he is to give any meaning to the years remaining to him, and if once and for all he is to face up to the woman who, thirty years on, he is still in love with.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 檢察官Benjamin Esposito即使退休，也無法忘記一宗沒得到公平裁決的姦殺案。他決定以此懸案作小說題材，重新展開偵查，廿五年的記憶亦一一被喚起：孑然一身的檢察官、逍遙法外的強暴犯、人間蒸發的遺屬、嗜酒如命的拍擋和美麗動人的法庭書記……記錄一件謎案，穿插一段真愛。沉澱的回憶一再回來，他們的觀點會否改變？未來又會怎樣改寫？
